destinations.name: Cairo & Giza
destinations.tagline: The City of a Thousand Minarets & The Great Pyramids
destinations.description: Home to the Giza Plateau, the Sphinx, and the new Grand Egyptian Museum, Cairo effortlessly bridges ancient dynasties with vibrant Islamic history and buzzing bazaars.

destinations.name: Luxor
destinations.description: Ancient Thebes boasts the monumental Karnak and Luxor temples on the East Bank, and the legendary Valley of the Kings and Hatshepsut Temple on the West Bank.

destinations.name: Aswan
destinations.tagline: The Jewel of the Nile & Nubian Wonder
destinations.description: A tranquil paradise where the Nile weaves around granite boulders and emerald islands. Renowned for its colorful Nubian culture and sacred temples.

destinations.name: Abu Simbel
destinations.description: Carved into the sandstone cliff of Lake Nasser, these monumental temples are an architectural triumph that honors King Ramesses II and Queen Nefertari.

destinations.name: Alexandria
destinations.description: Founded by Alexander the Great, Alexandria captures a romantic Mediterranean air with its iconic modern library, Roman catacombs, and seafront citadel.

destinations.name: Hurghada
destinations.tagline: The Riviera of the Red Sea
destinations.description: Vibrant coastal haven celebrated for all-inclusive luxury resorts, snorkeling with wild dolphins, diving world-class reefs, and golden desert quad safaris.

destinations.name: Sharm El Sheikh
destinations.tagline: The Crown of the Sinai Peninsula
destinations.description: World-renowned diving haven located at the southern tip of Sinai, gateway to Ras Mohammed National Park, Tiran Island, and Mount Sinai.

destinations.name: Dahab
destinations.tagline: Bohemian Coastal Serenity & The Blue Hole
destinations.description: Laid-back paradise for divers, free-divers, and windsurfers. Famous for the legendary Blue Hole and tranquil Bedouin seaside cafes.
highlights: Bedouin Candlelit Dinners in the Wadi

destinations.name: Marsa Alam
destinations.description: Egypt's most pristine southern marine destination, famed for swimming with wild dugongs, giant green sea turtles, and pristine coral atolls.

destinations.name: Siwa Oasis
destinations.tagline: The Enchanted Berber Oasis of Alexander
destinations.description: Nestled near the Libyan border in the Great Sand Sea, Siwa is an ancient Berber sanctuary of olive groves, salt lakes, and the Oracle of Amun.

destinations.name: White Desert
destinations.tagline: Surreal Chalk Sculptures Under the Milky Way
destinations.description: An otherworldly national park of wind-carved chalk sculptures resembling mushrooms, icebergs, and sphinxes. Renowned for luxury Bedouin glamping.

destinations.name: Fayoum Oasis
destinations.tagline: Desert Waterfalls & Valley of the Whales
destinations.description: Just 90 minutes from Cairo, Fayoum offers serene Lake Qarun, Tunis pottery village, desert waterfalls, and the UNESCO site of Wadi El Hitan.

destinations.name: Edfu
destinations.description: A vital stop on all Nile cruises, housing the magnificent sandstone temple dedicated to the falcon god Horus, remarkably preserved under desert sand for centuries.

destinations.name: Kom Ombo
destinations.tagline: The Dual Temple of Sobek and Haroeris
destinations.description: Perched dramatically on a bend of the Nile, this unique temple is symmetrically dedicated to Sobek the crocodile god and Horus the elder, with an adjacent mummified crocodile museum.

destinations.name: Saint Catherine
destinations.tagline: The Sacred Mount Sinai & Ancient Monastery
destinations.description: Standing at the foot of Mount Sinai where Moses received the Ten Commandments. The monastery is one of the world's oldest continually operating Christian monasteries.

destinations.name: Wadi El Natrun
destinations.description: A serene desert depression midway between Cairo and Alexandria, home to four historic 4th-century Coptic Christian monasteries.

destinations.name: Nuweiba
destinations.tagline: Sinai's Tranquil Beach Oasis & Colored Canyon
destinations.description: Peaceful coastal strip on the Gulf of Aqaba, gateway to the dazzling geological maze of the Colored Canyon.

destinations.name: Ain Sokhna
destinations.description: Just an hour from Cairo on the Gulf of Suez, offering sandy beaches, thermal hot springs, and luxury coastal resorts.

destinations.name: Black Desert
destinations.description: A stark landscape of conical hills topped with black volcanic dolerite, creating a dramatic contrast against golden sand dunes.
